mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_notice INNER JOIN sys_user_notice ON sys_user_notice.notice_id = sys_notice.id WHERE sys_user_notice.user_id = #{userId} AND sys_user_notice.read_flag = '0' AND sys_notice.status = '1' AND sys_notice.del_flag = '0'

SELECT sys_user.id, sys_user.username, sys_user.nickname, sys_user.avatar FROM sys_user_notice INNER JOIN sys_user ON sys_user.id = sys_user_notice.user_id WHERE sys_user_notice.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND sys_user_notice.read_flag = #{readFlag} AND sys_user.del_flag = '0' AND sys_user.status = '0' ORDER BY sys_user_notice.read_time DESC, sys_user_notice.user_id
